messages:
Mae Liu: Quick check — the new /v1/generate routing params landed in staging. Are we still honoring legacy `model_id` fallback when `routing_hint` is provided? I noticed some requests that should have fallen back to small-legacy are hitting the default large model.

Jonathan Reyes: I think the current behavior in staging first resolves `model` (new canonical id), then `routing_hint`, then `model_id` as last-resort fallback. Was that the intent?

Sandeep K: That was the intended compatibility order, yes. But there's a bug where if `routing_hint=region:eu|tier:premium` is present we skip the fallback lookup. I filed a quick repro.

Alyssa (DevEx): Repro would help. Can you paste the minimal request? We should also confirm SDKs don't break. I saw an error in node SDK tests.

Sandeep K: Repro: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"prompt":"hi","routing_hint":"region:eu|tier:premium","model_id":"redwood-text-small-v1"}'``` Expected: fallback to `redwood-text-small-v1` if tier/region unavailable. Observed: routed to `redwood-text-large-v2`.

Kai (Eng-Platform): Thanks, Sandeep. Root cause: the `routing_hint` parser returns a non-empty map and then we always prefer route candidates from hints even if no matching capacity exists; we didn't then consult `model_id` canonical mapping.

Mae Liu: That matches what I saw. Two questions: 1) Do we change runtime to consult legacy `model_id` after hint failure? 2) Do we communicate this in the API contract (breaking change) or keep backward compat?

Jonathan Reyes: My vote is to keep backward compat by doing a second-pass resolution: after routing-hint candidate selection fails, call `resolve_model_from_model_id(model_id)` and try those candidates before falling back to default. That keeps any existing customers relying on `model_id`.

Alyssa (DevEx): +1 — better UX. If we do that, we should add a note in the response metadata so customers can detect that a fallback happened (non-breaking): e.g. `served_model`, `routing_decision: "fallback_to_model_id"`.

Kai (Eng-Platform): Agreed. Proposed small API-level metadata change (non-breaking): add `x-served-model` header and a `routing` object in the response body under `meta` (no change to primary schema). Eg: ```json
{
  "id":"...",
  "output":"...",
  "meta":{
    "served_model":"redwood-text-small-v1",
    "routing":{"source":"model_id_fallback","hints":["region:eu","tier:premium"]}
  }
}
``` This is additive so safe.

Sandeep K: That solves detection. Runtime fix is ~2 files: parse + second-pass resolver. I can target a patch PR.

Mae Liu: Great. Any objections to implementing as patch and keeping `model_id` for 6 months then deprecating with a header warning?

Jonathan Reyes: No objections. We should add a feature flag `compat.model_id_fallback` default on, toggleable per-tenant. That helps Dedicated/Private customers who may need different policies.

Alyssa (DevEx): I'll update the SDKs to surface `meta.routing` and the `X-Served-Model` header in the response objects (node + python). Will also add a deprecation warning in the docs if header `X-Deprecation` is present.

Kai (Eng-Platform): I'll own the runtime PR. Sandeep, can you open the reproducer + tests as part of the PR? Tagging: @jonathan for config/flags review.

Sandeep K: Yep — opening PR now: https://git.redwood.ai/p/infer-platform/+/12345 — tests included.

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline triggered for branch `fix/modelid-fallback` — currently queued.

Mae Liu: Timeline? We need this in staging by EOD so DevEx can validate SDKs.

Kai (Eng-Platform): I'll fast-track review, aim to merge + staging deploy in the next 3 hours. If anything blocks, I’ll call it out here.

Jonathan Reyes: For deprecation policy, ops: add a metric to track how many requests rely on `model_id` fallback so PM can schedule sunset. I'll create a dashboard tile.

Alyssa (DevEx): Also pinging on the PR for a quick SDK patch review once merged.

Mae Liu: Thanks all. Action items: 1) Sandeep open PR with repro/tests (done) 2) Kai review + merge and stage deploy (owner: Kai) 3) Alyssa update SDKs to expose meta/header (owner: Alyssa) 4) Jonathan add metric/dashboard for model_id fallback usage (owner: Jonathan). Will follow up in #product-apis once staged. :thumbsup:
